landing.title: Novel Buds
landing.tagline: Write creative novels with AI assistance

about.title: What is Novel Buds?
about.description: Novel Buds is an intelligent writing platform that helps you bring your stories to life. Chat with AI to create characters, build worlds, and develop plots — all organized in one beautiful workspace.

agentWriting.title: Build Worlds & Write with Agent
agentWriting.description: Expand and refine your ideas with the agent. Provide character context and world-building details, then let the agent craft scenes, develop plotlines, and write dialogue that stays true to your vision.

agentQuery.title: Ask the Agent
agentQuery.description: As your story grows, it's easy to lose track of setting details. When you need a refresher, just ask — the agent searches your story database and provides grounded, referenced answers.

translation.title: Multi-language Support
translation.description: Have your agent write in another language to naturally infuse cultural nuances into your project. Then translate it into your own language for comfortable reading — all within the same workspace.

anim.sourceText: 月明かりが古い図書館の窓から差し込み、埃っぽい本棚に長い影を落としていた。エレノアは静かに通路を歩きながら、指先で革の背表紙をなぞった。
anim.targetText: Moonlight streamed through the old library windows, casting long shadows across the dusty shelves. Eleanor walked quietly down the aisle, her fingertips tracing the leather spines as she passed.

promptEditor.title: Prompt Editor
promptEditor.description: Customize your agent's writing style, personality, and tone with the prompt editor. Change the system prompt and watch your agent transform — from a Victorian novelist to a modern thriller writer.
